content: Corrosion (superfly/corrosion README, fetched 2026-10, plus fly.io/blog/corrosion Oct 2025): each node keeps a local SQLite DB; local changes gossiped cluster-wide; conflict resolution via CRDTs (CR-SQLite); SWIM membership via Foca library; peer traffic over QUIC (Quinn) with encryption; periodic full-state sync with a subset of nodes (anti-entropy); SQL read/write API; HTTP streaming subscriptions based on SQL queries (watch); file-based schemas with on-the-fly updates; Rhai templates to render config files from state; Consul ingestion mode (Consul replacement); CLI + agent; docs marked WIP, snapshot/bootstrap details not enumerated in README.
